extra_quotes: By pairing live area telemetry with the already synthesized base trajectory, DIFFSCOPE cancels early mapping inflation, reducing residual variance during initial mapping by 73.6×, and stops uncompetitive runs via a lower bound calibrated on other design lineages.

Across 43 design families from small blocks to processors with millions of cells, DIFFSCOPE uniquely recovers the optimum of exhaustive synthesis in every family, cuts total evaluation work by 44.9% (1.81×), and reaches 2.18× on L-tier designs.
Limitations include evaluation on Design Compiler, the NanGate 45 nm library, and area targets.
